q: What does BRSR ask about zero liquid discharge, and how do we answer it?
title: BRSR zero liquid discharge question
short: Principle 6 essential indicator 5 asks whether the company has a mechanism for zero liquid discharge, and if yes, for details of its coverage and implementation. Answer site by site: which plants run ZLD, since when, what the system treats, and how much water it recovers.
audience: Plant heads and EHS teams at listed companies

p: BRSR Principle 6, essential indicator 5: Has the entity implemented a mechanism for Zero Liquid Discharge? If yes, provide details of its coverage and implementation.

ul: Plants covered and plants not covered, with the reason.
Treatment steps: for example, effluent treatment, reverse osmosis, evaporator and crystalliser.
Water recovered and reused in kilolitres, from flow meters.
Whether ZLD is a consent condition from the pollution control board.

sections.h: Link it to the water table
p: The ZLD answer should agree with the water discharge figures in the same principle. A plant claiming ZLD with discharge to surface water in the table will be questioned. ZLD evaporators also use energy, which shows up in your energy and Scope 1 or 2 figures.

senseible: Senseible reads kWh, litres and kg from electricity bills and fuel invoices into a dated record per site, with the factor and source on every line, and prepares BRSR drafts from that data. Reports are self-declared drafts.

sources.label: SEBI LODR Master Circular, 11 July 2023, Annexure 16 (BRSR format)
